description.value: The Dayton Audio SS12-PR 12" Signature Series Passive Radiator makes it easy to achieve extended low-frequency performance from compact enclosures, making it the ideal partner for the SS12-22 subwoofer. With the same heavy-duty cast aluminum frame, anodized aluminum cone, and rubber surround as its powered counterpart, the SS12-PR provides the excursion capability needed to complement today's high-output drivers. Thanks to Dayton Audio's Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) tuning system, adjusting and securing the added mass is quick, accurate, and reliable. Product Highlights Signature Series styling with cast aluminum frame, aluminum cone, and rubber surround - visually identical to the SS12-22 driver Passive radiator design enables deep bass extension from compact enclosures without port noise Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) places added mass between spider and surround for stability and symmetry Simple tuning with threaded bolt, wing nut, and nylock nut for secure mass adjustment Includes five 116 g weights for flexible tuning options Perfect companion for the Dayton Audio SS12-22 in compact high output systems
